challenge.name: The Locked Shadow
challenge.description: A supplier contract for the next promotion week is already signed, and the team cannot deploy the new model without a shadow run to verify it. #reliability_ruth# demands a fully automated and governed shadow environment to protect the live forecast, while #automation_alex# insists on keeping it manual to avoid breaking the current pipeline stability.

output.content: The manual hand off to the serving endpoint is a bottleneck we need to eliminate. {efficiency_emilia} wants the transition to fire automatically so the morning order window never waits on a human click. She also wants the endpoint running on a managed platform to reduce the operational overhead of keeping it alive. This setup should scale without adding headcount. The goal is to make the pipeline self sustaining so we can focus on model quality instead of infrastructure babysitting. More automation here directly improves our ability to handle the next promotion week without risking a late forecast.
output.reclassify_reason: The text explicitly states that more automation directly improves the ability to handle future promotions, indicating that exceeding the basic request for automation would make the stakeholders happier by ensuring reliability during peak times.
